title: Explain prompts queued behind a named-selection predecessor capture hold
outcome: Users see the exact predecessor turn refs and release condition when prompts wait for named-selection capture.
acceptance: Queueing an ordinary or human prompt behind an unresolved acknowledged predecessor visibly reports PENDING with the deciding check, exact waiting turn refs and capture-or-own-terminal release condition.
The notice distinguishes a pending hold from terminal refusal and unknown state, and reports actual settlement without fabricating a report.
